concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-transaction-adjust-authorization-node]] - Node.js adjustment of an `authorized` transaction's amount, with lower-amount partial-reversal attempts, higher-amount incremental-authorization attempts, and the some-market merchant-fee qualification
warnings: Keep eligibility scoped to transactions in `authorized` status; this page does not establish broader payment-method, merchant, or processor availability.
Preserve `attempt` for both the lower-amount partial reversal and higher-amount incremental authorization; do not guarantee either outcome.
Do not equate authorization adjustment with capture or settlement submission; the page changes the authorized amount and documents no resulting transaction-status transition.
Keep the fee language modal and qualified: authorization and capture can incur merchant fees in some markets, with no fee amount, market list, or per-adjustment guarantee stated.
